structured.answer: I'd take option 1, "החברה בראש השורה": I tap S&P and get one short list where each row starts with a company I know, plus its fee and 3/5-year return, so I can compare right away. Fairly sure, even though option 3 has the "מומלץ" badge.

stuck.why: Endless list of every הראל track then every מור track; I scrolled and scrolled and got bored, would have closed the page here
A wall of brown boxes all around 0.5-0.7%; everything looks alike and there is no return shown, and the מומלץ badge made me hesitate between it and option 1
Had to match the ring colours to the 99%/97% numbers written beside it with little dots

used: Top option buttons: 1. החברה בראש השורה / 2. קיבוץ לפי חברה / 3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים (מומלץ)
Option 1 S&P group header 'עוקב מדד s&p 500 · 12 מסלולים'
Bold company names per row (מנורה מבטחים, הראל, מגדל, כלל, הפניקס, מיטב)
Option 3 grid S&P column percentages, glanced
skimmed: Second 'כל המסלולים' list under the grid
skipped: Grey intro paragraphs above each option
Product chips row and type filter chips
Footnotes 'התשואה היא תשואת עבר...' and orange 'בשרטוט בלבד' notes
unsure_meaning: ring colours (guessed teal = מניות, yellow = מט"ח)
brown shading in grid (guessed darker/orange = more expensive)
'2 מסלולים' small text in grid cells
not_found: A plain 'which one to pick' line

findings.what: Every row repeats the same labels (מניות/מט"ח, ההחיסכון/מההפקדות, פחות מ־3 שנים, clock icons); I reread them each time to find what differs
Option 2 is a huge scroll of one company's tracks at a time; comparing companies for the S&P is lost in it
Grid is a sea of look-alike percentages and brown shades with no returns; colour meaning not next to it
Ring chart numbers are written beside it with tiny coloured dots; I had to look back and forth
Fees only as small percents, nothing in shekels, so they feel like nothing
'עוד לא דווח' and 34% on איילון looked odd/worrying
